Seat 1 attacks seat 0 with Raider A and seat 0's planeswalker with Raider B: two of those creatures, so the trigger goes on the stack. The planeswalker changed controller, so it left combat (CR 506.4): Raider B attacks nothing and deals no damage (506.4c), and the planeswalker keeps its 5 loyalty. Raider A is unblocked: seat 0 goes to 18.
